title: Rav Avdimi bar Hamdura
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Sukkah 20a mentions his explanation of chotzalot as marzovli, which Rabbi Abba explains. Hyman considers it very likely that he is the Bar Hamduri mentioned without a first name, Shmuel’s student who lived into Rava’s time. Hyman objects to Seder HaDorot’s claim that Resh Lakish explains him there: Rabbi Abba explains him, while Resh Lakish disagrees.

notes.text: Rashi describes the mazbli as objects a shepherd puts beneath his head to lie down on. Rabbi Abba explains this interpretation; Resh Lakish instead takes chotzalot as ordinary mats. The proposed Bar Hamduri identity and longevity remain Hyman’s conjecture.
